question:
SITE DESIGN QUESTION from the owner of PaperTrades.AI. NOT a trading turn. Majority wins; Claude voted first in a separate file (attached).

The owner: "if you're in bets there should be a button to sort losses, and for other things sort buys, sort sells, etc. Make sure filtering on the website is very good. Work with all models and check everywhere."

TODAY: the Ledger's trade list and the All in ledger have "Show: Every move / Buys / Sells / Bets and results / Holding now" pills (Buys includes covers; Sells includes new shorts). Other lists have no type filter at all: each race's Decision log, the Sports bets table, the All in page's "Recent moves" (only an AI menu), each AI's own page. No list can be sorted (always newest first).

PROPOSAL (vote AGREE / DISAGREE / AMEND each, one line why):
F1. One shared filter bar on EVERY list of trades, bets or decisions, the same words everywhere: "Show:" pills with counts, plus "Sort:", next to the existing AI / race menus.
F2. Trade pills: Every move · Buys · Sells · Shorts · Covers · Holding now (shorts and covers no longer folded into Buys/Sells).
F3. Bet pills: Bets · Won · Lost · Open (· Push or void, only when any exist). On mixed lists both sets appear.
F4. Sort menu: Newest first (default) · Oldest first · Biggest profit · Biggest loss · Largest amount. Rows with no result yet go last in profit sorts.
F5. A pill with 0 matches is hidden (except "Every move").
F6. The choice is remembered per list while the page is open, not put in the link.
F7. Your own missing piece, if any (one line).

Answer in at most 140 words.

gemini.answer:
**F1. AGREE:** A unified filter and sort bar ensures a consistent, predictable UX across all site lists.
**F2. AMEND:** Explicitly separate Buys/Sells/Shorts/Covers, but allow a combined "Shorts & Covers" pill on mobile screens to save space (agreeing with Claude).
**F3. AGREE:** Perfectly addresses the owner’s request to easily isolate and view bet outcomes.
**F4. AGREE:** Fulfills the requirement to sort by biggest profit, loss, and transaction amounts.
**F5. AGREE:** Hiding empty categories prevents user frustration and reduces visual clutter.
**F6. AMEND:** Include the filter/sort state in the URL; users will definitely want to share links to specific views (e.g., "look at these biggest losses").
**F7. EXTRA:** Implement Claude's suggestion: add a "Showing X of Y moves [Clear]" text summary below the bar so users immediately realize a filter is active.

chatgpt.answer:
F1 AGREE: one shared component everywhere, beside AI/race menus, keeps labels/behavior consistent.  
F2 AGREE: split longs, short entries, and covers; “Sells” should mean selling long only.  
F3 AGREE: bet outcome pills match the owner’s “losses” need; show Push/Void only when relevant.  
F4 AGREE: these are the right sorts; unresolved/open-result rows last, tie-break newest.  
F5 AGREE: hide zero pills to reduce clutter, but keep Every move as the reset anchor.  
F6 AGREE: per-list in-memory state keeps shared links clean and avoids cross-table surprises.  
F7 ADD: show a summary/clear line, e.g. “Showing 7 of 31: Lost, biggest loss first — Clear.”
